Consulted all three released readers at P025 upper piano. PlayScore grace D5, D6 half and tie agree with print. SmartScore grace as quarter/E6 rejected. Audiveris D6 half/tie at incorrect onset3/2 rejected for timing. No source majority used.

Readers also invent spacer rests; do not preserve them as authored rests.

Source doubling and invented rests rejected. Audiveris fingering 1 beneath P033 D5 is not accepted automatically; no clear printed digit in full system image, preserve for close final check.

Compared released P049 piano events for all readers after print inspection: each supports D4 half onset2 and G4 final quarter, despite frozen candidate values. PlayScore grace transcription omits first F#5; three grace heads visible in enlarged print.
